claims.text: The resort has seven restaurants and bars across the Culinary Island, Grand Sunset Beach and Fari Marina Village.

findings.quote: This private island resort features 7 restaurants and bars between the dedicated Culinary Island, Grand Sunset Beach, and Fari Marina Village

claims.text: Each beach and water villa has a private infinity pool.

findings.quote: Each of our Maldives beach and water villas include a private infinity pool for guests to enjoy a refreshing swim with a view.

claims.text: Every villa has a dedicated Aris Meeha, or island butler, who is available around the clock.

findings.quote: The legendary Ritz-Carlton service is refined by a distinguished Aris Meeha for each of our villas in the Maldives.

findings.note: Island butler available around the clock

claims.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa is a ring-shaped building set over the lagoon.

findings.quote: The Ritz-Carlton Spa at The Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands is a ring-shaped sanctuary nestled over the turquoise lagoon.

claims.text: The resort is on the Fari Islands, a man-made archipelago in North Male Atoll.

findings.quote: The Ritz-Carlton Maldives is the second resort to open in the Fari Islands, a four-island man-made archipelago in the North Male Atoll

claims.text: La Locanda serves Southern Italian cuisine.

findings.quote: wake up to the aromas of freshly brewed coffee in La Locanda, where Southern Italian cuisine and customs unfold

claims.text: Private dining can be arranged at Mystique Garden, Grand Sunset Beach, Beach Cove or Sandback.

findings.quote: the enchanting Mystique Garden, the golden shores of Grand Sunset Beach, the secluded charm of Beach Cove, or a private dining experience in North Male Atoll at Sandback

claims.text: The villas run mainly on solar power, and the resort is single plastic-free.

findings.quote: The villas are mainly run on solar power (each villa’s roof is slightly sloped to accommodate these solar panels), and the resort is single plastic-free.

claims.text: Fari Marina Village has a beach club, boutiques, an art installation by James Turrell and upscale restaurants.

findings.quote: Fari Marina Village, built around a vibrant Fari Beach Club, high-end boutiques, an immersive art installation by James Turell, Fari Lagoon Coral Adoption & Marine Biology Center, and a selection of upscale restaurants
findings.note: All elements present; page spells the artist Turell

claims.text: Ritz Kids gives young guests their own space, where playtime can mean video games or a dip in the dedicated outdoor pool.

findings.quote: Young guests have a space of their own at our Ritz Kids, where playtime can mean video games or a dip in the dedicated outdoor pool.

claims.text: At sunset, Bodu Beru drummers perform a ceremony that honors the oldest surviving tradition of the Maldives, followed by a flaming ceremony.

findings.quote: the celebration of sunsets with an elegant performance of Bodu Beru drums that honors the oldest surviving tradition of the Maldives, followed by a flaming ceremony

claims.text: The circular villas were designed by Kerry Hill Architects, who are known for many of Aman's resorts.

findings.quote: the circular villas devised by the renowned Kerry Hill Architects, responsible for many of Aman's greatest resorts

claims.text: The resort brought in Jean-Michel Cousteau's Ambassadors of the Environment to lead its marine education and exploration program.

findings.quote: The resort tapped Jean-Michel Cousteau’s Ambassadors of the Environment to lead their marine education and exploration program

claims.text: A drone conservation project monitors the ocean habitat for turtles entangled in abandoned fishing nets, known as ghost nets.

findings.quote: our ground-breaking drone conservation project monitors the ocean habitat for turtles entangled in abandoned fishing nets, also known as ghost nets.

claims.text: The resort is a 45-minute boat ride from Velana International Airport.

findings.quote: a four-island man-made archipelago in the North Male Atoll based a 45-minute boat ride from Velana International Airport.

claims.text: Venue closing days at the restaurants may change seasonally.

findings.quote: Please be aware that venue closing days may change seasonally to keep your dining and social experiences dynamic and aligned with the vibrant surroundings.

claims.text: Overwater villa stays have an age restriction of 13 and up, though parents or guardians can sign a waiver when booking.

findings.quote: Due to safety concerns, the age restriction for overwater villa stays is 13 and up, though parents or guardians can sign a waiver upon booking.
